0022600216.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-2, 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West) enter on a four-game winning streak and are 3-2 on the road, while the Portland Trail Blazers (6-3, 3rd in the Northwest and 8th in the West, 1.5 games back) have lost two straight. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), with Robert Williams III listed as day-to-day for rest and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 124-95 win in Oklahoma City on December 31, 2025.
